summary: A 1937 CCC-built cab in the Frank Church wilderness, out of service for years and reached only by trail; its design and build date are disputed.

facts.design: R-4 plan 80 cab, 15 x 15 ft with a pyramid roof (register); two other sites call it an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned and out of service for many years; no later visit report found

access.note: Inside the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness. Access is by trail only. Used only by wilderness patrols since 1986.

visit.trail_note: Access is only by trail, inside the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness.

events.note: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps. Two other sites (firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts) date a 'L-4 cab' to 1935; see notes

Idaho Fire Lookouts lists Blaine Cornell as known staff

notes_for_editor: Build date and design conflict. The register, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Intermountain Histories give 1937 and an R-4 plan 80 cab similar to an L-4. firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts give a 1935 L-4 cab, attributed to Kresek; the story reports both and follows the register. Elevation: the register gives 7,139 ft (2,176 m), matching the record's 2176.0 m; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 7223 ft (about 2,202 m). Current condition: no visit report newer than the register's 2009 photo was found; the cab's present state is unknown. Staff names appear only in the events notes. No Forest Service wilderness or closure page was read.
